{{Top|leg}}
The '''CN-12 sensor chip''' was one of the objects needed for the completion of the [[Silencer (superweapon)|Silencer]]. The CN-12 was kept on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] until the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Nox|Kallig]], with the help of the [[Cult of the Screaming Blade]], retrieved the CN-12 to use for the Silencer being constructed under [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Valion Pyron|Pyron]] to use against [[Darth Thanaton]].
